# Colgrid

> Colgrid is a real-world game you play with friends. Pick a route through a neighborhood, go to each stop together, take on the mission there, and earn XP, levels and badges on a web pass that carries forward to every route and every city. Colgrid is based in Salt Lake City, Utah, and is opening soon.

## Key facts

- What it is: a persistent real-world game (not a one-off outing). Your team, level and badges carry forward.
- Where: Salt Lake City, Utah. Each route runs through one walkable neighborhood, with stops at local makers, kitchens and public places.
- How it works: start a team, invite friends with a link, and play whenever the places on the route are open. The app shows where to go and checks that you're at each stop (your phone's location plus something only visible on site).
- Who it's for: adults 18+: friends, partners, family and coworkers.
- Competitive? No. Nobody is ranked; it's about the experience. Everyone earns XP, levels and badges.
- No download: Colgrid runs in the phone's browser at colgrid.app and can be added to the home screen.
- Companies: private team experiences. Request a quote: https://getcolgrid.com/companies
- Local businesses: experiential marketing for shops, restaurants and makers. A business can become a stop in the game: https://getcolgrid.com/business
- Contact: https://getcolgrid.com/contact
